description: Test cases for competitor dashboard skill — validates HTML generation, CSV export, and GitHub integration

evals.prompt: Given a Google Sheet with 5 companies (Terra AI, GeologicAI, Fleet Space, VerAI, Stratum AI), 20 funding events, and 100 update log entries, generate an interactive HTML dashboard. Include: company search/filter, investor timeline visualization, update log viewer. Return the generated index.html file. Verify that the HTML is self-contained (all data embedded), renders in a browser, and search functionality works.
evals.expected_output: Single index.html file that renders in browser with working search, timeline visualization, and company detail view for all 5 companies

evals.prompt: Export the same 5-company dataset (from eval 0) to three CSV files: competitors.csv (company snapshots), events.csv (funding events), and update_log.csv (field change history). Verify CSV structure matches the schema (column headers, data types, date formats). Ensure all companies, events, and log entries from the source data are included with no truncation.
evals.expected_output: Three CSV files (competitors.csv with 5 rows + header, events.csv with ~20 rows + header, update_log.csv with ~100 rows + header) with correct column headers and data types

evals.prompt: Generate dashboard and CSVs (from eval 1), then simulate a GitHub push to a public repo (mohan-competitive-intelligence). Create commit message formatted as '[auto] daily dashboard update — YYYY-MM-DD'. Verify: (1) files are pushed to correct paths (/dashboard/index.html, /data/competitors.csv, /data/events.csv, /data/update_log.csv), (2) previous day's CSV is archived to /data/archive/, (3) commit message is properly formatted. Return confirmation of all files pushed.
evals.expected_output: Confirmation that HTML file is in /dashboard/, all CSV files are in /data/, previous CSVs are archived in /data/archive/, and commit message follows template
